description: The boot screen: read the boot state, act on a failed service, reveal the log folder. Then the studio itself: save a file the user picked, and check for an update.

comment: The window loads http://127.0.0.1:<port> and not tauri://localhost (§2.1),
so every permission below reaches a REMOTE origin as far as the capability
system is concerned. Without this block the IPC is denied on the studio page
and every Download button fails silently. The port is a range, not a
constant: ports.rs falls back through 8765-8785 when 8765 is taken, which is
in ports.rs proves this literal matches every port the shell can choose.
